node.label: Awards & honours
node.summary: Prizes and the people who won them.

facts.text: Chennai-based TB nonprofit **REACH** won the **Kochon Prize 2026**, the first Indian civil-society organisation to do so; shared with Kenya's Centre for Health Solutions and the Marshall Islands TB Control Program.
facts.plain: Chennai-based TB nonprofit REACH won the Kochon Prize 2026, the first Indian civil-society organisation to do so; shared with Kenya's Centre for Health Solutions and the Marshall Islands TB Control Program.

facts.text: **Nirmala Lakshman**, Director of The Hindu Group, won the **Sharjah Award** for Best International Non-Fiction Book for *'The Tamils: A Portrait of a Community'* (Aleph Book Company, Jan 2025).
facts.plain: Nirmala Lakshman, Director of The Hindu Group, won the Sharjah Award for Best International Non-Fiction Book for 'The Tamils: A Portrait of a Community' (Aleph Book Company, Jan 2025).

facts.text: **Han Kang** (South Korea) won the **International Booker Prize (2016)** for *The Vegetarian* and the **Nobel Prize in Literature (2024)**.
facts.plain: Han Kang (South Korea) won the International Booker Prize (2016) for The Vegetarian and the Nobel Prize in Literature (2024).

facts.text: **Kavli Prize** (astrophysics): Vasily Belokurov, Amina Helmi, Rodrigo Ibata, for discovering past mergers of the Milky Way.
facts.plain: Kavli Prize (astrophysics): Vasily Belokurov, Amina Helmi, Rodrigo Ibata, for discovering past mergers of the Milky Way.

facts.text: **490** personnel received the **Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak** on 31 Oct (Patel's birth anniversary), including 14 CBI officers. It was instituted by an MHA notification of **1 Feb 2024**.
facts.plain: 490 personnel received the Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak on 31 Oct (Patel's birth anniversary), including 14 CBI officers. It was instituted by an MHA notification of 1 Feb 2024.

facts.text: Odisha activist **Prafulla Samantara** won the **Goldman Environmental Prize** in **2017**.
facts.plain: Odisha activist Prafulla Samantara won the Goldman Environmental Prize in 2017.
